name: full_literals_recovery
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,hashlib,subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd(); ids=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']
for i in ids:
 raw=Path('originals/%s.jsonl'%i).read_bytes(); o=json.loads(raw); token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")',raw).group(1); s=o['statement']; p=json.loads(Path('provenance/%s.json'%i).read_text()); p.update(statement_token=token.decode(),statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),statement_utf8_sha256=hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'provenance/%s.json'%i],input=json.dumps(p,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True); assert r.returncode==0
 print('\nID',i,o['title'],'\nSOURCE',o['source_url'],'\n',s)
